clips.title: The story
paras: Gaxim Rustfizzle is an ambitious gnome scholar and tinker stationed at a small Alliance camp along the Webwinder Path in Stonetalon Mountains. A representative of the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences, he seeks to prove to skeptical night elves that advanced artifice and alchemy can preserve their woodland realm. His scientific curiosity is matched by a fierce vendetta against the destructive operations of the Venture Company.

While night elves traditionally rely on ancient druidism and nature magic, Gaxim Rustfizzle arrived in the craggy passes of Stonetalon to demonstrate a radically different perspective. Representing the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences, he genuinely believes that calculated mechanisms and chemical solutions can defend and restore Kalimdor's wilderness just as effectively as prayers to Elune. Camped alongside the sentinel Kaela Shadowspear on the Webwinder Path, he works tirelessly to convince his tall, reclusive allies of engineering's ecological merits.

Much of Gaxim's energy is channeled against the Venture Company, whose clear-cutting and industrial greed desecrate nearby Windshear Crag. Believing that crude goblin machinery deserves neither respect nor mercy, Gaxim coordinates covert operations and volatile chemical sabotage against their logging operations. To him, crippling their shredders and stealing their schematics is not merely tactical warfare—it is a practical demonstration that superior gnomish intellect always triumphs over careless corporate plunder.
